threat_event: Ransomware or an intruder reaches BAS and access control through an integrator's remote access and disrupts several properties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Persistent integrator access outside group PAM; flat building networks
existing_controls: Local control of life-safety systems; on-site engineers
treatment_plan: Integrator access through group PAM; segment building networks (group plan GR-06)

threat_event: Parking pay stations on networks shared with BAS bring building systems into PCI DSS scope or expose card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pay stations share networks with BAS at 6 garages
treatment_plan: Separate pay station networks; segmentation test

threat_event: Tenants receive lookalike-domain letters with new remittance details and pay rent to an attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 property website domains at DMARC monitor-only; no standing remittance letter to tenants
treatment_plan: DMARC reject on property domains; standing remittance letter to every tenant

threat_event: Building controller configurations cannot be restored after an integrator compromise
treatment_plan: Property-held configuration backups for all controllers

threat_event: A fraudulent vendor or tenant-refund bank change is processed in Property accounts payable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One approver for bank changes; AP outside the payment factory
treatment_plan: Interim call-back and second approver now; move Property AP into the payment factory

threat_event: Covered video equipment remains in use at federally leased properties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 46 cameras and 3 recorders from a covered manufacturer installed in 2018
regulatory_driver: N23-R02 (52.204-25) applicability to GSA leases under counsel review (unverified)
treatment_plan: Replace by 2026-12-15 regardless of the legal answer

threat_event: Access control compromise lets an intruder reach federal tenant floors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Access control servers on flat networks
treatment_plan: Segment access control networks first (group plan GR-06)

threat_event: An attack on building systems goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAS servers and building networks not in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Onboard BAS servers; passive OT network monitoring at 10 largest properties

threat_event: Property staff follow 2024 standards that conflict with group policy
The parking technology service provider is breached and card data is stolen
treatment_plan: Annual attestation review; written responsibility matrix

threat_event: Tenant portal account takeover exposes tenant contacts and work orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal supports MFA but does not require it

threat_event: Video of tenants and visitors is misused or kept too long
Tenant security layouts in tenant improvement drawings are shared too widely in the PDPP
treatment_plan: Security drawings restricted to named users
owner: Property VP of development and construction

threat_event: The single parking technology service provider has an outage
treatment_plan: Accepted: revenue impact limited; manual fallback exists

threat_event: Hurricane or flooding damages building systems at Florida properties
treatment_plan: Elevate controllers in flood-prone equipment rooms

threat_event: Lease abstraction AI misreads critical dates or obligations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Abstracts not always checked against the lease

threat_event: BAS energy optimization AI changes setpoints outside safe ranges
Default passwords on building controllers are used to take control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 found default credentials on 14 controllers at 3 properties
treatment_plan: Reset all controller credentials; add to integrator acceptance checklist
